g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-304 Drum-top vibratory sifter (built in house) · rev B
Product contact: 2B sheet, #4 polish Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]; welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967 (underside)
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
3 in BPE FERRULE on R170 [6.693] at 200°
welded to the lid edge, hanging down
CAP Ø34 x 13, Ø30 bore x 10

svg.text: cap: FDA silicone 60 Sh, push fit
tube end sealed by the disc (W2 all round)
P1-304-501 LID GASKET (1:4) · FDA silicone 3 mm
316L tube Ø30 x 2 x 28 + disc Ø30 x 3
FDA silicone 60 Sh, moulded or cut from Ø34 rod
1. Weld ferrules from the underside first (seal, ground flush to the bore), then fillet on top; lid flat 1.0 after welding (planish if needed).
2. Pads: square to the lid 0.5; all three pad faces coplanar 0.5 (the deck must be pressed evenly).
3. Keeper tabs: fit with the lid on the body and the gasket in place, so the latches pull 2 mm over centre.
